description: x402 conversion funnel report for one service (why agents probe but do not pay): funnel (total_probes, bounces, paid, conversion_rate), traffic_classes and top_abandoned_endpoints. Data exists only for services that report through the publisher middleware; a service with no events in the window answers 404 no_data and is not charged. FREE with X402_ADS_PUBLISHER_KEY for your registered services (the service id is bound to your key at registration); otherwise $0.05 USDC on Base via x402. Without a publisher key or WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY, returns the x402 payment challenge.
